description: Shared build facts of the Linux x86_64 desktop products (RFC 0027 L0): the target, the pinned host GCC and pkg-config dependencies, the linux-gcc toolchain provider, the dev and release flavors (RFC 0023) and the waf-engine stage. The pins equal the v1 desktop profiles' (portal-linux-wayland-native-vulkan.json); those v1 files fold into this fragment when L1 moves their Python readers to product.profile.

dev.description: Development instrumentation kept (the trees ./play and ./play_p2 build today)

release.description: RFC 0023 release play build: release flavor flags and link-time optimization

ktx.description: dev with the pinned KTX2 reader (RFC 0008 F3): KTX2 textures in native Vulkan clients and the Hammer shell's previews. Provision the reader first: pbrt_map_toolchain.py provision --steps ktx-reader
